title: Implement L R peak meter rendering
description:
Implement Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp only, matching Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h. Render L/R peak and RMS LED-style bars on the message thread via a capped juce::Timer. Pull or snapshot levels that the processor publishes lock-free; never call into the audio thread; never allocate on an audio path.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (meter level fields / atomics)
- Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp (Timer paint pattern for consistency)

Implementation requirements:
- Include MeterComponent.h and implement all declared methods
- timerCallback at the header's 30-60 Hz cap snapshots L/R peak and RMS and calls repaint on the message thread only
- paint() draws separate L and R vertical (or project-consistent) LED/bar meters for peak and RMS with sensible dB scaling and clamp
- Decay/hold may run on the message thread only
- No mutex-based audio-to-UI transfer; use header atomics/lock-free levels only
- Pre-size any path/geometry work outside the audio thread

Do not modify the header, SpectrumVisualizer, or processor/editor in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp exists and implements MeterComponent from Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp timerCallback refreshes L/R peak and RMS at a capped 30-60 Hz rate on the message thread
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp paint draws distinct L and R peak/RMS meter bars
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: call repaint() from the audio thread
use blocking locks for audio-to-UI transfer

allowed: implement MeterComponent.cpp against the existing header
snapshot atomics/levels on Timer and paint L/R peak/RMS bars
